$comment: Per-file budgets for served public assets. Measured baseline 2026-10-10 (raw/gzip bytes): islands admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2483/1213, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, join-widget 574/376 (new, ceilings 1024/512; re-measured after focus-on-load + guided-fallback behavior: 1185/593, ceilings 1536/768 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the load/error/timeout handlers and the invite-fallback message, not bloat), member-profile 9471/3500 (re-measured 2026-10-12 after merging main: field-error association plus main #709 unsaved-draft warning, #722 focus and #752 progress feedback; ceiling 12288/4608 = measured x1.25 rounded up), past-events 3602/1490, rsvp-button 14498/4201, model-context 2593/1195 (new, ceilings 3584/1536), attendees-live 4494/1660 (new, ceilings 4608/1792; measured after the non-rotating fragment header, attendee-page preservation and the stale-note/focus review fixes; re-measured 4789/1811 after the same-event document admission gate, ceilings 5120/2048 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the mount-key check, not bloat); styles 4749/1611 (esbuild 0.28.1 --minify from assets/); theme 11965/2776, theme-tokens 1204/330, event-theme 5688/1462, profile-theme 6528/1518, schedule-theme 3932/1197 (authored in public/, no assets/ source; re-measured 5279/1489 after the member-board sticky headers plus viewer highlight, archive overflow-wrap, and cancelled-grid badge stacking rules, ceilings 5632/1792 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the reviewed rules, not bloat). The auth-status gzip ceiling uses the repository's x1.25 rule on its 2026-10-10 baseline (1213 -> 1536 B) to cover two approved fail-safe auth changes: bounded sign-out feedback and the session-read deadline when abort is ignored; raw ceiling is unchanged. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B). Earlier history: minified baseline 2026-10-03 admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2081/1009, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, member-profile 6138/2414, past-events 3350/1397, rsvp-button 13662/4001, styles 4749/1611; baseline 2026-09-30 events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth and every top-level public/*.css file must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. assets/ holds the reviewed sources for islands and styles.css; public/ holds the deterministic build output for those (node ci/minify-assets.mjs --check fails on drift). Theme stylesheets are served as authored. Served behavior is unchanged: the binder suite executes the minified bytes.
